name: Lexical Boundary Breakout
description: Premature termination of string, identifier, or literal boundaries via quotes, backticks, brackets, or dollar tags.

name: Relational Predicate Logic Mutation
description: Mutating boolean evaluation trees in WHERE, HAVING, and JOIN ON clauses via boolean operators (AND, OR, NOT, XOR).

name: Relational Set Operations (UNION/EXCEPT)
description: Appending independent relation sets to primary queries using UNION, UNION ALL, EXCEPT, or MINUS.

name: Scalar Expression & Function Injection
description: Injecting scalar subqueries, arithmetic expressions, type casts, and built-in functions into scalar evaluation slots.

name: Statement Batching & Stacked Execution
description: Semicolon statement chaining executing secondary DDL, DML, DCL, or procedural blocks.

name: DML Assignment & Tuple Mutation
description: Injecting column assignments in UPDATE SET or row tuples in INSERT VALUES.

name: Structural Clause Manipulation
description: Mutating structural query modifier clauses (ORDER BY, GROUP BY, LIMIT, OFFSET, WINDOW).

name: Transaction & Procedural Control
description: Injecting transaction boundaries (COMMIT, ROLLBACK, SAVEPOINT) or procedural concurrency locks.

name: Dynamic Schema DDL & DCL Mutation
description: Injecting structural schema definitions (CREATE TABLE AS, GRANT, REVOKE, TRUNCATE) in dynamic execution slots.

name: Common Table Expression (CTE) Recursion Chaining
description: Injecting recursive WITH clauses or anchor queries to traverse relational hierarchies or cause computational exhaustion.

name: Database Object & Search Path Hijacking
description: Manipulating dynamic schema resolution paths (SET search_path) or fully qualified object identifiers.

name: Custom Type Coercion & Operator Override
description: Injecting custom user-defined operators (OPERATOR(schema.op)) or complex domain casting rules.
